name: Sea Creature Bones
summary: On Darkshore, Sea Creature Bones wash ashore with the bodies of massive sea creatures. Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde gathers samples for the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus, where the cause of the strandings is under investigation.

sections.title: A Portent on the Shore
sections.body: Massive sea creatures now fling themselves onto Darkshore’s shallows and perish there. Giant threshers among them are far larger than those native to these waters. To the night elves, this sudden increase is an ominous portent. Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde was sent by the Temple of the Moon to Auberdine to gather bones from the beached creatures. Hippogryphs carry the specimens to Darnassus for close examination.

sections.title: Carrion and Scavengers
sections.body: The immense carcasses draw local scavengers. Greymist murlocs gather to feed on the dead and dying creatures, then fiercely defend their feeding grounds. They are too weak to hunt beasts of this size. So investigators and adventurers must fight through their packs along Mist's Edge to recover bone fragments for study.

faq.q: Why are these creatures washing ashore?
faq.answer: The exact cause remains unknown. Occasional strandings are a natural hazard, but the sudden, dramatic increase alarms the priestesses of Elune, who consider it unnatural and have begun a formal investigation.

aliases: who turns in sea creature bones
faq.answer: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde gathers the bones in Auberdine for the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. Scholars and priestesses there hope to learn what is disturbing the sea.

faq.q: Did the murlocs kill these giant beasts?
faq.answer: No. The Greymist murlocs are too weak to bring down marine beasts of that size. They gather in numbers to feed after the creatures wash ashore.

faq.q: Where are the bones recovered from?
aliases: where to find sea creature bones
faq.answer: The bones come from massive carcasses stranded along Darkshore, especially on the sands south of Auberdine and along Mist's Edge.

angles.text: As a night elf, you know these sudden mass strandings deeply trouble your people, who revere harmony in the natural world. They see the beachings as a dark omen that calls for the Temple of the Moon’s attention.

As a druid, you see the inexplicable deaths of ancient marine predators as a sign of deep disturbance in the waters off Kalimdor. Such a disturbance troubles any guardian devoted to ecological balance.
